description:
Less is more. Eurobike XC560 Road Bike with retro-styled design make it Lighter and more fashionable, making your riding more relaxed and pleasant.

You can easily change the gears and enjoy the speed excitement with 21 speeds.

The front and rear alloy caliper brakes make it easy to stop, providing you with more precision and control while riding.

Recommended for rider's height 5'7" ~6'2". Max weight up to 250 lbs.

85% of the parts are pre-assembled. The package includes free pedals, assembly accessories and tools. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us and we will be at your service at any time.

Product description

YH-XC560 Lightweight 700C Road Bike 54cm Frame 21 Speed Commuter Bikes

Leading the retro trend of road bicycles

Less is more.

YH-XC560 road bike equipped with aluminum rims and slim frame is not only terse and decent but also refined and elegant.

Size of 54 cm fits up for 5'7” to 6'2.

Road biking is a nice way to keep healthy and make friends with new people.

Let's go cycling together!

Product details

Smooth Drivetrain System

YH-XC560 has a smooth drivetrain system. Shimano three front gears and seven in the rear which ensure a smooth ride.

Alloy Caliper Brake System

Front and rear caliper brakes provide a stable response with reliable stopping action on the pavement. The caliper brake with simple structure is more portable than the disc brake, making it easy to maintain.

Urban Commuter Bikes

YH-XC560 road bike meets people's dual needs of commuting and physical exercise, perfectly integrating into people's urban life.

Stand-over Height

Stand-over Height of YH-XC560 IS 77CM. Frame size of 54 cm fits up for 5'7” to 6'2. Tips:There should be one inch between the top tube and the crotch of the rider when the rider’s feet are in the ground.

Configuration Data

Why choose YH-XC560?

Retro-styled road bike

Lighter and more comfortable

Design for both exerciser and commuter

Makes for a great gift！

Installation Steps

Flip the stem, install front wheel

Install handlebar

Install pedals (Pay attention to the direction of rotation)

Install saddle

Tune the wheels

Tune the brakes, derailleurs

How to assemble this bike?

It needs a few minute.

This bicycle arrives with 85% assembled. You need to install the front wheel, pedals, handlebar, seat and pump up the tires under the guidance of the assembly instructions.

Bicycle assembly instruction is in the package, please read it more carefully before installing the bike and tuning the brake and speed system.

All tools are included in the package. Seriously following the installation instruction to assemble it，your bike will work well！

If it is possible, we recommend bringing it to a local shop for a safety check/tuning by a bike mechanic to riding and at regular intervals thereafter.
